title: FeedbackEnvelopeV1
description: Pipeline-agnostic feedback envelope. K1 detectors emit; K0 ports.observe ingests into st_feedback_signals. Wire shape mirrors k0.feedback.envelope.FeedbackEnvelope (Pydantic) with extra=forbid semantics; the K0 side re-validates to apply per-pipeline payload schemas via FeedbackSchemaRegistry.

feedback_id.description: UUID stringified; if absent the K0 side mints one. Idempotency key for dedupe_by_envelope_id.

pipeline_id.description: Target K0 pipeline (e.g. P02, P08, P03).

tenant_id.description: Multi-tenant routing; required by K0 schema-registry validation.

space_id.description: Tenant space id; required by K0 schema-registry validation.

provenance.description: Audit trail; recall_context_hash, source_message_id, feedback_timestamp, etc.

event_timestamp.description: Original event time (UTC ISO-8601), if different from emission.

payload.description: Pipeline-specific payload validated by K0 FeedbackSchemaRegistry against pipeline_id.

FeedbackCorrelation.description: Links feedback to originating K0/K1 operations and target entities.

event_ids.description: st_hipp_events.event_id values touched by the originating turn.

wal_position.description: Singular form (legacy); merged into wal_positions on the K0 side.

target_entity_type.description: Kind of entity the feedback targets, e.g. event.

target_entity_id.description: Entity id the feedback targets, e.g. st_hipp_events.event_id.
